time.desc: The company submitted its delayed annual and quarterly financial reports and re-complied with the exchange's reporting requirements, and the delisting crisis was lifted.
The company disclosed its annual report and confirmed that the financials did not need to be restated, and the exchange officially confirmed that the case was closed in compliance with regulations
The company appoints new independent directors and general counsel to strengthen corporate governance structure
The company released quarterly unaudited financial results, with net profit falling sharply quarter-on-quarter and gross profit margin continuing to decline.

After the company announced its quarterly financial report, its stock price plummeted, its revenue and gross profit margin fell short of expectations, and its full-year revenue forecast was significantly lowered.
The company disclosed in its annual filing that its internal control over financial reporting had significant deficiencies and failed to operate effectively.
Company executives revised the report on insider shareholding changes and supplemented the disclosure of spouse’s indirect shareholding information
Company co-founder and CEO arrested for alleged export control violations and faces multiple federal criminal charges
Company director resigns, appoints acting chief compliance officer, separates compliance function from financial responsibilities
The company's independent directors launched an independent investigation into employees suspected of smuggling chips, but did not set a timetable for completion.
The company's board of directors formally appointed a lead independent director to lead the internal investigation and hired external law firms and consultants to assist
The company discloses the size of cash and cash equivalents, bank debt and convertible bonds at the end of the quarter in its quarterly financial report
The company releases net sales performance guidance for the next quarter with its quarterly financial report.
